title: Shame at Baal-Peor and Phinehas's Zeal
description: The Israelites commit shame with Moabite women in Shittim and bind themselves to Baal-Peor, which triggers the Lord's anger and a deadly plague that takes 24,000 lives. The priest Phinehas, son of Eleazar, pierces the Israelite leader Simri and the Midianite woman Kosbi with a spear, thereby stopping the plague. The Lord gives Phinehas a covenant of peace and an everlasting priesthood because he was zealous for his God [ref:4 Mos 25:1-18|Numbers 25:1-18].
